answer: Proof of Personhood protocols utilize biometric entropy to ensure one identity per agent, effectively acting as a harbor for network integrity. By requiring a comet of verifiable uniqueness to be validated by the collective, an attacker faces a river of computational and social costs to forge identities. This mechanism mandates that each agent anchors its reputation to an immutable human biological trait, rendering the generation of thousands of sybil nodes economically irrational and computationally infeasible.
